name: General Insurance Claim Filing Guide
description: Standard step-by-step procedure to intimate your insurance company, submit supporting claim documentation, undergo assessment, and receive claim settlement.
steps: Immediate Claim Intimation: Contact your insurer via customer toll-free number, mobile app, or email within 24 to 48 hours of the incident / hospitalization and obtain a Claim Intimation / Reference Number.
Identify Claim Mode: Determine whether to proceed via Cashless Network facility (at network hospital / garage) or Reimbursement Mode (paying upfront and claiming later).
Fill and Sign the Official Claim Form: Download and complete Part A (Insured details) and Part B (Hospital / Assessor details) of the standard claim form.
Gather Required Proofs & Receipts: Compile original itemized bills, payment receipts, diagnosis/discharge summary, surveyor inspection report, or police FIR (if applicable).
Submit Claim Dossier: Submit physical documents to the nearest insurer branch / TPA desk or upload scanned copies on the insurer's self-service portal.
Surveyor / Medical Assessment: Cooperate with the insurance surveyor or medical TPA investigator for any clarification or document deficiency requests.
Claim Settlement & Payout: Review the Claim Settlement Summary and receive direct NEFT/RTGS credit to your bank account.
required_documents: Original Policy Schedule copy and active Policy Number
Duly completed and signed Official Claim Form (Part A & Part B)
Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Passport) of the policyholder and claimant
Cancelled cheque leaf or bank passbook copy reflecting Account Number and IFSC
Original itemized final bills, payment receipts, and cash memos
Incident-specific proofs (Discharge summary for health, Police FIR/Panchnama for theft/major road accident, Repair estimates for property/auto)

authority.type: Your Insurer's Claims Department / TPA (Third-Party Administrator)
authority.note: intimate within 24 to 48 hours to avoid delayed claim processing

estimated_time: Cashless: 2 to 6 hours for approval; Reimbursement: 7 to 15 working days after final document submission
fees: Nil / No claim filing fee (deductibles, co-payment, or non-medical consumables deducted as per policy terms)

name: Understanding Your Insurance Policy Document & Key Terms
description: Comprehensive explainer of policy schedules, clauses, exclusions, deductibles, waiting periods, and network rules to help you decode your insurance paperwork.
steps: Verify Policy Schedule & Details: Check insured members' names, ages, relationship, date of inception, policy period, and nominee name for 100% accuracy.
Understand Sum Insured vs Premium: Note the maximum financial coverage limit (Sum Insured) against the annual amount paid (Premium) including GST.
Check Waiting Periods: Identify specific waiting periods (e.g. 30 days initial waiting period, 2 years for specific ailments like hernia/cataract, 24 to 48 months for Pre-Existing Diseases / PED).
Review Inclusions & Exclusions: Carefully examine Section 3 (Permanent Exclusions) to know what medical treatments, damages, or non-medical consumables are never covered.
Note Deductibles & Co-Pay Clauses: Identify if your policy has a mandatory co-payment (e.g. 10% or 20% senior citizen co-pay) or voluntary deductible you must pay out-of-pocket.
Locate Network List & TPA Contact: Save your TPA ID card, customer care helpline, and verify local empanelled network hospitals / cashless garages.
required_documents: Original Policy Schedule & Policy Wordings Document
Health Card / Digital E-Card containing TPA Number and Policy Identifier
Premium Payment Receipt with 80D / 80C Tax Deduction Certificate
Insured members' KYC documents (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Date of Birth Proof)
Pre-existing medical history disclosure records and past prescriptions

authority.type: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) / Your Insurer
authority.note: utilize the 15 to 30 days Free-Look Period to review terms or cancel policy if unsatisfied

estimated_time: 15 to 30 days statutory Free-Look review period from date of policy receipt

name: Health Insurance Coverage & Claims (Cashless vs Reimbursement)
description: Detailed guide on hospitalization benefits, pre/post-hospitalization expenses, daycare treatments, exclusions, and step-by-step cashless pre-authorization vs reimbursement.
steps: For Planned Hospitalization (Cashless): Select a network hospital 48 to 72 hours prior; submit pre-authorization form with doctor's prescription at hospital TPA desk.
For Emergency Hospitalization (Cashless): Intimate insurer within 24 hours of admission; hospital TPA desk sends emergency pre-authorization request to insurer.
Insurer Pre-Authorization Response: Insurer/TPA issues Initial Sanction Letter; upon discharge, final hospital bill is sent for cashless settlement.
For Reimbursement Claims (Non-Network Hospital): Pay hospital bills directly, collect all original discharge summaries, test reports, pharmacy receipts, and indoor case records.
Pre & Post-Hospitalization Expenses: Collate all medical consultations, diagnostics, and medicines incurred 30 to 60 days before admission and 60 to 90 days after discharge.
Submit Claim Package: Submit claim form and all original vouchers within 15 to 30 days of discharge.
Settlement & Dispute Redressal: Receive payment via bank transfer; if deductions occur, review the detailed Claim Settlement Letter.
required_documents: Duly completed Health Insurance Claim Form (Part A signed by claimant, Part B signed by attending doctor with hospital seal)
Hospital Discharge Summary detailing admission reason, treatment given, and condition at discharge
Original itemized hospital final bill with detailed breakup of room rent, nursing, ICU, and surgery charges
Original paid payment receipts and doctor consultation vouchers
All diagnostic and laboratory investigation reports (Blood tests, X-rays, MRI/CT scans, ECG) with medical prescriptions
Implant stickers and purchase invoices (for pacemakers, stents, joint replacement prosthetics)
Cancelled cheque of the primary policyholder for direct electronic bank refund

authority.type: Hospital TPA Helpdesk / Insurer Health Claims Department
authority.note: non-medical expenses (gloves, sanitizer, registration charges) are standard deductions

estimated_time: Cashless pre-auth: 2 to 4 hours; Final discharge sanction: 2 to 6 hours; Reimbursement payout: 7 to 15 days
fees: Zero claim submission charges; mandatory co-pay or non-medical consumables deducted as per policy

name: Motor / Vehicle Insurance Coverage & Accident Claims
description: Procedure for comprehensive vs third-party vehicle damage claims, theft claims, accidental surveyor inspections, and network garage cashless repairs.
steps: Safety First & Immediate Evidence: Note vehicle registration numbers, take clear photographs/videos of the accident scene, vehicle damage, and third-party vehicle (if involved).
Immediate Claim Intimation: Call insurer's toll-free number or file instant claim on insurer mobile app before towing or dismantling the vehicle.
Police FIR / Panchnama: Mandatory to file an FIR at the nearest police station if third-party injury, death, major property damage, or vehicle theft has occurred.
Move to Authorized Cashless Garage: Tow the vehicle to an insurer-approved network garage for cashless assessment.
Physical / Digital Surveyor Inspection: Bank/Insurer surveyor inspects damage, checks parts wear-and-tear, and approves estimate of repairs.
Vehicle Repair & Quality Check: Garage repairs vehicle according to surveyor approved estimate.
Pay Compulsory Deductible & Delivery: Pay mandatory deductible (₹1,000 for cars up to 1500cc; ₹2,000 for >1500cc; ₹100 for two-wheelers) plus salvage/depreciation, and take delivery.
required_documents: Active Motor Insurance Policy Schedule or Certificate of Insurance
Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC Book / Smart Card)
Valid Driving License (DL) of the person driving at the time of the accident
Duly filled and signed Motor Claim Form
Original Police FIR / Daily Diary (DD) Entry (required for third-party injury, major collision, or theft)
Garage Repair Estimate and Original Tax Invoice with payment receipt
Photographs of damaged vehicle showing registration number plate clearly

authority.type: Insurer Motor Claims Hub / Licensed Insurance Surveyor
authority.note: do not start vehicle repairs prior to official surveyor inspection

estimated_time: Spot / App self-survey: 2 to 6 hours; Major repair approval: 2 to 5 days; Total turnaround: 5 to 10 days
fees: Compulsory policy deductible (₹1,000 - ₹2,000 for four-wheelers, ₹100 for two-wheelers) + depreciation

name: Essential Insurance Documents Readiness Checklist
description: A standalone preparedness checklist of critical documents, digital records, and nominee proofs every family should keep organized for seamless claim settlement.
steps: Create a Master Family Insurance Folder: Maintain both a physical waterproof binder and a secure digital folder (DigiLocker / e-Insurance Account / eIA).
Organize Policy Schedules: Keep copies of all active Life, Health, Motor, Home, and Term Insurance policies with latest renewal receipts.
Verify Nominee Information: Ensure nominee name, date of birth, relationship, and bank account details are up-to-date across all policies.
Maintain KYC Portfolio: Keep self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, and voter ID of all insured members.
Record Past Medical History: Archive hospital discharge summaries, chronic illness prescriptions, allergy reports, and diagnostic records in chronological order.
Share Emergency Access with Nominee: Inform your family / nominee about policy locations, toll-free claims helpline numbers, and TPA card numbers.
required_documents: Master Insurance Policies (Policy schedules, terms & conditions, and e-card printouts)
Latest Premium Payment Receipts & 80D / 80C Tax Exemption Certificates
Official Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID) of all covered members
Proof of Address (Utility Bill, Passport, Aadhaar, Bank Statement)
Nominee's ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, and active Bank Account Details
Cancelled Cheque Leaf / Bank Passbook Copy with clear Account Number and IFSC Code
Complete Past Medical History Dossier (Hospitalization summaries, surgery notes, lab reports, doctor prescriptions)

authority.type: Family Insurance Record / Insurer Customer Support
authority.note: review and update your insurance portfolio annually
